One card per wallet; every trait is a fact about the claimant wallet that minted the card, never about the holder. Direct-read traits are read live from the settled WhitelistCurator and the IdentityMD collection; chain-proven, panel-attested and shared-fact traits are attested by the IMD oracle through the Intake and verified in the registry.
